title: Integral Secant Distributions and Line-Code Obstructions for Complete (k,n)-Arcs
description: This preprint develops sharp integer bounds for the numbers of maximal secants through the points of a complete higher arc and its complement. On characteristic-compatible rational equality families, modular stability turns near equality into bounded repair. In characteristic three, centered secant moments produce a small-weight word in the projective-plane line code. Two integer-shell inequalities force three generator lines and an additional q/3-o(q) points. This proves t_{2q/3+1}(2,q) >= q^2/3 + 5q/3 - o(q) over q=3^h.
